The Applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with C.R.No.1417 of 2022,
registered at Hadapsar Police Station, Pune city, on 12.11.2022, under sections 272,
273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 3(1)(zz)
(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as 'FSS Act').
2.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

Heard Mr. Ali, learned counsel for the applicant and Ms. Mahalakshmi Ganapathy,
learned APP for the State.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: 3. The prosecution case is that the F.I.R. was lodged by 2 of 4 26-aba-3385-22 one Anil Gavte who was the Food Safety Officer, Pune.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: He was called by the police officers on 12.11.2022 at 12.30p.m.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text:
The police had intercepted a tempo bearing Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94363034/

sentences.text: The tempo was searched and the banned food articles namely scented tobacco, pan masala etc. worth Rs.5,58,000/- was seized.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: Four persons namely Anil Dhepe, Shoeb Ansari, Shahanawaj Ansari and Hidayat Udekari were named in the F.I.R.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: Out of them, Anil Dhepe was the driver.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: He informed that, he had brought the seized goods with the help of other three persons.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: The total value of the seized articles was worth Rs.5,58,000/-.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: The investigation revealed that the driver Anil Dhepe was given these food articles by the present applicant and other accused Darshan Turekar and Pankaj Turekar.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: Therefore, the applicant is apprehending his arrest.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that, the applicant has not committed any offence.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: He is not connected with the arrested accused.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: He is wrongly implicated.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text:
He further submitted that,
Section 328 of the I.P.C. is not attracted.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json
Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: Learned APP opposed these submissions.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: She submitted that, in the present application, the applicant was protected by ad-interim order.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: However, the applicant has other antecedents of a similar nature i.e. C.R.No.585 of 2022 registered at MIDC Bhosari police station, C.R.No.37 of 2015 and 1407 of 2020 both registered at Hadapsar police station under the similar sections.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: She further submitted that, this Court, in an identical matter i.e. in A.B.A.No.207 of 2024 involving Section 328 of the I.P.C. has passed an order today.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: She submitted that, the legal aspects discussed in that order are squarely applicable to the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: 6. I have considered these submissions.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: As far as the applicability of Section 328 of the I.P.C. is concerned, the said issue is discussed in detail in the aforementioned order dated 30.01.2024 passed in A.B.A.No.207 of 2024.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: The reasoning and findings recorded under that order are squarely applicable to the facts and arguments in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: The applicant has other antecedents, as mentioned herein above, of a similar nature.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: On all these counts the applicant does not deserve protection U/s.438 of 4 of 4 26-aba-3385-22 the Cr.p.c.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: His custodial interrogation is necessary.
sentences._hearing_file: Mandar Rajendra Thosar vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2024.json

sentences.text: 7. The application is rejected.
